thinking: The request is sent and nothing has come back yet. useAgentStatus picks it automatically.
reasoning-trace: The model streams its reasoning before the answer. Automatic with useAgentStatus.
sources: The answer cites documents or web pages as it streams. Automatic with useAgentStatus.
tool-call: The agent is running a tool (search, file read, API call). Automatic with useAgentStatus.
streaming: Answer text is arriving. Automatic with useAgentStatus.
stalled: The stream is open but nothing new has arrived for a while (5 seconds by default). Automatic with useAgentStatus.
error: The request or stream failed and the user can retry. Automatic with useAgentStatus.
done: The answer finished. A quiet check that fades. Automatic with useAgentStatus.
agent-plan: The agent shows a multi-step plan and progresses through it. The app passes the steps.
approval: The agent needs a person to allow or deny an action before it continues. The app passes the action and callbacks.
queue: The request waits in a queue or is rate-limited. The app passes the real position or retry time.
file-processing: An uploaded file is being read and prepared. The app passes the real stage and progress.
